name: Arabic-stsb_multi_mt_extend-benchmark
description: An Arabic adaptation/extension of the STS-B semantic textual similarity benchmark that provides sentence pairs in Arabic (via multilingual/machine translation) with human similarity scores. It measures models' ability to predict graded semantic similarity between Arabic sentence pairs.
evaluation_method: Pearson / Spearman correlation against human similarity scores
reputation: A niche but useful resource for Arabic STS evaluation; moderate visibility among multilingual NLP practitioners.
